feature.name: landing
feature.purpose: Public marketing page ported from the legacy HTML landing into the React frontend.

layout.section: Fixed header, hero headline, upload dropzone, and resume showcase with stickers and score badge.
Three-card problem framing with legacy illustration assets.
Centered value statement that connects pain points to the product promise.
Four-step workflow around the central resume illustration and score overlays.
Six benefit cards using the original icon set from the HTML landing.
Single pricing card with resume preview, price, feature list, and CTA.
Logo, email link, and legal links.
